to the parent tag.
items.translation: 用于嵌套的 `<spring:param>` 标签的回调钩子，以将它们的值传递给父标签。

items.source: Add the given, single request value.
items.translation: 添加给定的单个请求值。

items.source: Add resource handlers for serving static resources.
items.translation: 添加用于提供静态资源的资源处理器。

items.source:
Add a callback to be triggered when the specified singleton becomes available
in the bean registry.
items.translation: 向 Bean 注册表添加一个回调，以便在指定的单例可用时触发。

items.source: Provide request parameters identifying the request for this FlashMap.
items.translation: 提供用于标识该 FlashMap 请求的请求参数。

items.source: Add a handler to invoke when concurrent handling has timed out.
items.translation: 添加一个处理器，在并发处理超时时被调用。

items.source: This implementation delegates to the LoadTimeWeaver, if specified.
items.translation: 此实现如果指定了 LoadTimeWeaver，则将其委托给 LoadTimeWeaver。

items.source: Override this method to add view controllers.
items.translation: 覆盖此方法以添加视图控制器。

items.source: Tag interface for Advice.
items.translation: Advice 的标记接口。

items.source:
Enumeration used to determine whether JDK/CGLIB proxy-based or
AspectJ weaving-based advice should be applied.
items.translation: 用于确定应应用基于 JDK/CGLIB 代理的增强还是基于 AspectJ 织入的增强的枚举。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by classes that hold the configuration
of a factory of AOP proxies.
items.translation: 由持有 AOP 代理工厂配置的类所实现的接口。

items.source: Base class for AOP proxy configuration managers.
items.translation: AOP 代理配置管理器的基类。

items.source:
Interface allowing extension to the Spring AOP framework to allow
handling of new Advisors and Advice types.
items.translation: 允许扩展 Spring AOP 框架以处理新 Advisor 和 Advice 类型的接口。

items.source: Interface for registries of Advisor adapters.
items.translation: 顾问适配器注册表的接口。

items.source: Factory interface for advisor chains.
items.translation: 顾问链的工厂接口。

items.source: Invoked third (and last) after the request body is converted to an Object.
items.translation: 在请求体转换为 Object 后，会依次调用第三个（也是最后一个）方法。

items.source: The default implementation returns the body that was passed in.
items.translation: 默认实现返回传入的正文。

items.source: Invoked after a connection is successfully established.
items.translation: 在连接成功建立后调用。

items.source: Invoked on failure to connect.
items.translation: 连接失败时调用。

items.source: Invoked after the connection is closed.
items.translation: 连接关闭后调用。

items.source:
Invoked after the WebSocket connection has been closed by either side, or after a
transport error has occurred.
items.translation: 在 WebSocket 连接被任一方关闭或发生传输错误后调用。

items.source:
Invoked after WebSocket negotiation has succeeded and the WebSocket connection is
opened and ready for use.
items.translation: WebSocket 协商成功后且 WebSocket 连接已打开并准备就绪时调用。

items.source:
Invoked at the time of the first actual request, which effectively means
the expectations declaration phase is over.
items.translation: 在实际请求首次发出时调用，这实际上意味着期望声明阶段已经结束。

items.source: Invoked after the handshake is done.
items.translation: 握手完成后调用。

items.source: Move the cursor to the end of this row set.
items.translation: 将光标移至此行集的末尾。

items.source: Eagerly create the singleton instance, if necessary.
items.translation: 如有必要，急切地创建单例实例。

items.source:
Prepares the message endpoint, and automatically activates it
if the "autoStartup" flag is set to "true".
items.translation: 准备消息端点，如果“autoStartup”标志设置为“true”，则自动激活它。

items.source: Ensures compilation if used in a bean factory.
items.translation: 如果在 BeanFactory 中使用，可确保编译通过。

items.source: Initialize the UserTransaction as well as the TransactionManager handle.
items.translation: 同时初始化 UserTransaction 以及 TransactionManager 句柄。

items.source: Callback after a given method successfully returned.
items.translation: 在给定方法成功返回后调用的回调。

items.source:
After returning advice is invoked only on normal method return, not if an
exception is thrown.
items.translation: 返回建议仅在正常方法返回时调用，如果抛出异常则不会调用。

items.source:
Invoked right at the end of the singleton pre-instantiation phase,
with a guarantee that all regular singleton beans have been created
already.
items.translation: 在单例预实例化阶段的最末尾被调用，此时可以保证所有常规单例 Bean 已经创建完毕。

items.source: Representation of an alias that has been registered during the parsing process.
items.translation: 解析过程中已注册的别名的表示。

items.source: Notification that the given alias has been registered.
items.translation: 已注册给定别名的通知。

items.source: Common interface for managing aliases.
items.translation: 用于管理别名的通用接口。

items.source: Allocate a data buffer of the given initial capacity.
items.translation: 分配给定初始容量的数据缓冲区。

items.source: Add a request expectation.
items.translation: 添加请求期望。

items.source: Define the response.
items.translation: 定义响应。

items.source: Convenient adapter for programmatic registration of bean classes.
items.translation: 用于程序化注册 Bean 类的便捷适配器。

items.source:
Create a new AnnotatedGenericBeanDefinition for the given annotation metadata,
based on an annotated class and a factory method on that class.
items.translation: 为给定的注解元数据、该类的注解类以及该类上的工厂方法，创建一个新的 AnnotatedGenericBeanDefinition。

items.source: Copy constructor for use in subclasses.
items.translation: 用于子类的复制构造函数。

items.source: A MethodParameter with AnnotatedMethod-specific behavior.
items.translation: 具有针对 AnnotatedMethod 特定行为的 MethodParameter。

items.source: Simple ClassFilter that looks for a specific annotation being present on a class.
items.translation: 一个简单的 ClassFilter，用于查找类上是否存在特定注解。

items.source: Parser for the <context:annotation-config/> element.
items.translation: <context:annotation-config/> 元素的解析器。

items.source: Parser for the 'annotation-driven' element of the 'task' namespace.
items.translation: 用于解析'task'命名空间中'annotation-driven'元素的解析器。

items.source: Callback interface that can be used to filter specific annotation types.
items.translation: 可用于过滤特定注解类型的回调接口。

items.source:
Interface that defines abstract access to the annotations of a specific
class, in a form that does not require that class to be loaded yet.
items.translation: 定义了对特定类注解的抽象访问接口的接口，其形式不要求该类已加载。

items.source: A visitor to visit a Java annotation.
items.translation: 访问 Java 注解的访客。

items.source: Exception that gets thrown on illegal AOP configuration arguments.
items.translation: 在非法的 AOP 配置参数上抛出的异常。

items.source: Utility class for handling registration of AOP auto-proxy creators.
items.translation: 用于处理 AOP 自动代理创建者注册的实用类。

items.source: Class containing static methods used to obtain information about the current AOP invocation.
items.translation: 包含用于获取当前 AOP 调用信息的静态方法的类。

items.source:
Marker interface that indicates a bean that is part of Spring's
AOP infrastructure.
items.translation: 指示该 Bean 是 Spring AOP 基础设施一部分的标记接口。

items.source:
Exception that gets thrown when an AOP invocation failed
because of misconfiguration or unexpected runtime issues.
items.translation: 因配置错误或意外的运行时问题导致 AOP 调用失败时抛出的异常。

items.source:
Delegate interface for a configured AOP proxy, allowing for the creation
of actual proxy objects.
items.translation: 配置好的 AOP 代理的委托接口，允许创建实际的代理对象。

items.source: Utility methods for AOP proxy factories.
items.translation: AOP 代理工厂的实用方法。

items.source: Utility methods for AOP support code.
items.translation: 用于支持 AOP 代码的工具方法。

items.source: Thrown when AOT fails to process a bean.
items.translation: 抛出当 AOT 无法处理一个 Bean 时。

items.source:
Utility for determining if AOT-processed optimizations must be used rather
than the regular runtime.
items.translation: 用于确定是否必须使用 AOT 处理的优化而非常规运行时环境的工具。

items.source: Abstract superclass for all exceptions thrown by ahead-of-time processing.
items.translation: 所有由提前处理抛出的异常的抽象超类。

items.source: Throw when an AOT processor failed.
items.translation: 当 AOT 处理器失败时抛出异常。

items.source: Loader class used to actually load the services.
items.translation: 用于实际加载服务的 Loader 类。

items.source: Sources from which services were obtained.
items.translation: 服务来源。

items.source: Contract to format the API version for a request.
items.translation: 用于格式化请求的 API 版本的合约。

items.source: Configure API versioning for mapping requests to controller methods.
items.translation: 配置用于将请求映射到控制器方法的 API 版本控制。

items.source: Contract to insert an API version into the URI or headers of a request.
items.translation: 用于在请求的 URI 或标头中插入 API 版本的合同。

items.source: Contract to parse a version into an Object representation.
items.translation: 将版本解析为对象表示形式的合约。

items.source: Central interface to provide configuration for an application.
items.translation: 提供应用程序配置的中央接口。

items.source: Exception thrown during application context initialization.
items.translation: 应用程序上下文初始化期间抛出异常。

items.source: Class to be extended by all application events.
items.translation: 所有应用程序事件要扩展的类。

items.source: Interface that encapsulates event publication functionality.
items.translation: 封装事件发布功能的接口。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified
of the ApplicationEventPublisher (typically the ApplicationContext)
that it runs in.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行的 ApplicationContext（通常是 ApplicationEventPublisher）通知的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by application event listeners.
items.translation: 应用程序事件监听器需实现的接口。

items.source:
Convenient superclass for application objects that want to be aware of
the application context, for example, for custom lookup of collaborating beans
or for context-specific resource access.
items.translation: 适用于希望感知应用程序上下文的应用程序对象的便捷父类，例如用于自定义协作 Bean 的查找或用于基于上下文的资源访问。

items.source: Apply and remove, or remove Forwarded type headers.
items.translation: 应用和移除，或移除转发类型标头。

items.source: Apply the given customizers to the underlying bean definition.
items.translation: 将给定的自定义器应用于底层 Bean 定义。

items.source:
Apply the given property values, resolving any runtime references
to other beans in this bean factory.
items.translation: 应用给定的属性值，并解析此 Bean 工厂中对其他 Bean 的运行时引用。

items.source: Assist with configuration for handler method argument resolvers.
items.translation: 协助配置处理器方法参数解析器。

items.source: Helps to configure resolvers for Controller method arguments.
items.translation: 有助于配置控制器方法参数的解析器。

items.source: Create a new type descriptor as an array of the specified type.
items.translation: 创建指定类型的数组作为新的类型描述符。

items.source: Return the current set of model attributes as a Map.
items.translation: 返回当前模型属性集作为 Map。

items.source: Re-create the given mime type as a media type.
items.translation: 将给定的 MIME 类型重新创建为媒体类型。

items.source: Re-create the given mime types as media types.
items.translation: 将给定的 MIME 类型重新创建为媒体类型。

items.source: Superclass for all AOP infrastructure exceptions.
items.translation: 所有 AOP 基础设施异常的超类。

items.source: Interface implemented to provide an instance of an AspectJ aspect.
items.translation: 用于提供 AspectJ 切面实例的接口。

items.source:
Thrown in response to an ambiguous binding being detected when
trying to resolve a method's parameter names.
items.translation: 在尝试解析方法参数名称时检测到歧义绑定而抛出的异常。

items.source:
Interface for factories that can create Spring AOP Advisors from classes
annotated with AspectJ annotation syntax.
items.translation: 用于从使用 AspectJ 注解语法标注的类创建 Spring AOP Advisor 的工厂接口。

items.source: Spring AOP advice wrapping an AspectJ after advice method.
items.translation: Spring AOP 建议包装 AspectJ 后置建议方法。

items.source: Spring AOP advice wrapping an AspectJ after-returning advice method.
items.translation: Spring AOP 建议包装 AspectJ 返回后建议方法。

items.source: Spring AOP advice wrapping an AspectJ after-throwing advice method.
items.translation: Spring AOP 建议包装了 AspectJ 的 after-throwing 切面方法。

items.source: Utility methods for dealing with AspectJ advisors.
items.translation: 用于处理 AspectJ 顾问的实用方法。

items.source:
Spring AOP around advice (MethodInterceptor) that wraps
an AspectJ advice method.
items.translation: 环绕通知（MethodInterceptor）包装了 AspectJ 通知方法。

items.source: Spring AOP Advisor that can be used for any AspectJ pointcut expression.
items.translation: 可用于任何 AspectJ 点切面表达式的 Spring AOP Advisor。

items.source: Spring AOP advice that wraps an AspectJ before method.
items.translation: 环绕 AspectJ 前置通知的 Spring AOP 建议。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by types that can supply the information
needed to sort advice/advisors by AspectJ's precedence rules.
items.translation: 由能够按 AspectJ 优先级规则对建议/顾问进行排序的信息提供类型所实现的接口。

items.source:
AspectJ-based proxy factory, allowing for programmatic building
of proxies which include AspectJ aspects (code style as well
annotation style).
items.translation: 基于 AspectJ 的代理工厂，支持以编程方式构建包含 AspectJ 切面（代码风格及注解风格）的代理。

items.source: Utility methods for working with AspectJ proxies.
items.translation: 用于处理 AspectJ 代理的工具方法。

items.source: Type filter that uses AspectJ type pattern for matching.
items.translation: 使用 AspectJ 类型模式进行匹配的 Type 过滤器。

items.source:
Metadata for an AspectJ aspect class, with an additional Spring AOP pointcut
for the per clause.
items.translation: AspectJ 方面类的元数据，并针对 per 子句添加了额外的 Spring AOP 切入点。

items.source: Assertion utility class that assists in validating arguments.
items.translation: 用于辅助验证参数的断言工具类。

items.source: Test assertions that are independent of any third-party assertion library.
items.translation: 不依赖任何第三方断言库的测试断言。

items.source: Represents assignment.
items.translation: 表示赋值。

items.source: Match handlers that are assignable to a given type.
items.translation: 匹配可分配给给定类型的处理程序。

items.source: A simple filter which matches classes that are assignable to a given type.
items.translation: 一个简单的过滤器，用于匹配可分配给给定类型的类。

items.source: A return value handler that supports async types.
items.translation: 支持异步类型的返回值处理器。

items.source:
Raised when the response for an asynchronous request becomes unusable as
indicated by a write failure, or a Servlet container error notification, or
after the async request has completed.
items.translation: 当异步请求的响应因写入失败、Servlet 容器错误通知或异步请求完成而变得不可用时抛出。

items.source: Exception to be thrown when an async request times out.
items.translation: 异步请求超时时抛出的异常。

items.source: Helps with configuring options for asynchronous request processing.
items.translation: 有助于配置异步请求处理的选项。

items.source: A strategy for handling uncaught exceptions thrown from asynchronous methods.
items.translation: 处理异步方法抛出的未捕获异常的策略。

items.source: Return the request attribute value if present.
items.translation: 如果存在，则返回请求属性值。

items.source:
A non standard class, field, method or Code attribute, as defined in the Java Virtual Machine
Specification (JVMS).
items.translation: Java 虚拟机规范（JVMS）中定义的非标准类、字段、方法或代码属性。

items.source:
Interface defining a generic contract for attaching and accessing metadata
to/from arbitrary objects.
items.translation: 定义用于将元数据附加到任意对象以及从这些对象访问元数据的通用接口的通用契约。

items.source: Return the names of all attributes.
items.translation: 返回所有属性的名称。

items.source: The bean name of the internally managed auto-proxy creator.
items.translation: 内部管理的自动代理创建器的 Bean 名称。

items.source: Exception to be thrown from ElementFactory.
items.translation: 从 ElementFactory 抛出的异常。

items.source: Utilities for auto-proxy aware components.
items.translation: 用于自动代理感知组件的工具。

items.source:
Enumeration determining autowiring status: that is, whether a bean should
have its dependencies automatically injected by the Spring container using
setter injection.
items.translation: 用于确定自动装配状态的枚举：即，Spring 容器是否应使用 setter 注入自动注入 Bean 的依赖项。

items.source:
Fill in any missing property values with references to
other beans in this factory if autowire is set to "byName".
items.translation: 如果将 autowire 设置为"byName"，则使用此工厂中其他 bean 的引用来填充任何缺失的属性值。

items.source: Abstract method defining "autowire by type" (bean properties by type) behavior.
items.translation: 定义“按类型自动装配”（通过类型的 Bean 属性）行为的抽象方法。

items.source: Qualifier for resolving autowire candidates.
items.translation: 用于解析自动注入候选项的限定符。

items.source:
Strategy interface for determining whether a specific bean definition
qualifies as an autowire candidate for a specific dependency.
items.translation: 用于确定特定 Bean 定义是否为特定依赖项的自动注入候选者的策略接口。

items.source:
Marks a constructor, field, setter method, or config method as to be autowired by
Spring's dependency injection facilities.
items.translation: 标记构造函数、字段、Setter 方法或配置方法，以便由 Spring 的依赖注入设施进行自动装配。

items.source: Resolved arguments to be autowired.
items.translation: 已解析参数以进行自动注入。

items.source: Resolver used to support the autowiring of fields.
items.translation: Resolver 过去支持字段的自动注入。

items.source: Resolver used to support the autowiring of methods.
items.translation: Resolver 过去支持方法的自动注入。

items.source:
Obtain a resource object for the given name and type through autowiring
based on the given factory.
items.translation: 通过给定的工厂基于自动装配获取给定名称和类型的资源对象。

items.source: The annotation visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls.
items.translation: 该访问者必须向其委托方法调用的注解访问者。

items.source:
A marker superinterface indicating that a bean is eligible to be notified by the
Spring container of a particular framework object through a callback-style method.
items.translation: 一个标记超接口，指示该 Bean 可通过回调风格的方法由 Spring 容器通知特定的框架对象。
